name: NeuroVault_list_collections
description: List and browse neuroimaging statistical map collections from NeuroVault. Returns collections of brain images (fMRI, PET, EEG) contributed by researchers worldwide. Each collection contains metadata about the study, DOI, authors, and imaging parameters. NeuroVault hosts over 16,000 collections with 650,000+ brain images. Use limit and offset for pagination. Caveat: NeuroVault's public API has no working keyword/name search or filter parameter (confirmed live -- name/search/q/keywords all return the full unfiltered catalog) -- this only returns pages of the full, unfiltered collection catalog, which must be paged through client-side to find specific studies.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return per page (default 10, validated max 1000). Example: 10

offset.description: Number of collections to skip for pagination (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_offset.

next.description: URL for the next page of results

previous.description: URL for the previous page of results

url.description: URL to view collection on NeuroVault

acquisition_orientation.description: Slice orientation and tilt as free text, e.g. 'T > C-20.0 ' -- transverse, angled 20 degrees toward coronal.

autocorrelation_model.description: Serial-correlation model used, e.g. 'AR(1)'. Without it the first-level t values are not calibrated. Measured null on every row of the examples used here: NeuroVault leaves the whole provenance form optional and most submitters fill in only part of it, so absence means 'not reported', never 'not done'.

b0_unwarping_software.description: Software used for B0 unwarping, e.g. 'FSL topup'. Measured null on every row of the examples used here: NeuroVault leaves the whole provenance form optional and most submitters fill in only part of it, so absence means 'not reported', never 'not done'.

contributors.description: Contributors beyond the owner, as free text. Measured null on every row of the examples used here: NeuroVault leaves the whole provenance form optional and most submitters fill in only part of it, so absence means 'not reported', never 'not done'.

name: NeuroVault_list_collection_images
description: List all statistical map images in a specific NeuroVault collection. Returns image metadata including name, map type (T map, Z map, F map, etc.), cognitive paradigm/contrast annotations, and file download URLs. Use this to explore what brain maps are available in a study collection before downloading. Example: collection 457 (Human Connectome Project) has 48 images covering emotion, gambling, language, motor, relational, social, and working memory tasks.

collection_id.description: NeuroVault collection ID. Example: 457 (Human Connectome Project)

limit.description: Maximum number of images to return (default 10, validated max 1000)

offset.description: Number of images to skip for pagination (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_offset.

oneOf.description: Paginated list of images in the collection

map_type.description: Statistical map type: T map, Z map, F map, etc.

file.description: URL to download the NIfTI image file

not_mni.description: Whether image is NOT in MNI space

url.description: URL to view collection on NeuroVault

brain_coverage.description: Percent of the template brain the map covers, e.g. 99.98.

cognitive_contrast_cogatlas_id.description: Cognitive Atlas contrast id for the contrast, e.g. 'cnt_5531474e117df'. Measured on 2 of 5 images; it is what lets maps be pooled across studies by what they measure rather than by their titles.

contrast_definition.description: What the map contrasts, in the submitter's words, e.g. 'Faces minus Shapes'. This is the only statement of what the voxel values mean.

data_origin.description: Whether the map came from the 'volume' or from a surface, e.g. 'volume'.

figure.description: Figure in the source publication this map corresponds to. Measured null on every row of the examples used here: NeuroVault leaves the whole provenance form optional and most submitters fill in only part of it, so absence means 'not reported', never 'not done'.

file_size.description: Size of the stored map in bytes, e.g. 1180649.

is_thresholded.description: Whether the uploaded map is already thresholded, e.g. false. A thresholded map must not be fed into a meta-analysis as if it were a full statistic image.

is_valid.description: Whether NeuroVault's own validation of the file passed, e.g. true.

modify_date.description: When the image record was last changed, e.g. '2018-06-30T07:03:20.571134+02:00'.

number_of_subjects.description: Subjects behind the map, e.g. 486. The weight this map should carry in any meta-analysis.

perc_bad_voxels.description: Percent of in-brain voxels NeuroVault judged bad (zero, NaN or implausible), e.g. 65.7. A high value here is the usual sign that a map was uploaded already masked or thresholded.

perc_voxels_outside.description: Percent of non-zero voxels falling OUTSIDE the template brain, e.g. 26.19 -- the standard signal that the map is misregistered or in the wrong space.

reduced_representation.description: URL of a downsampled 4 mm .npy copy of the map, e.g. 'http://neurovault.org/media/images/457/transform_4mm_3128.npy'. Meant for similarity search; do not use it for inference.

statistic_parameters.description: The degrees of freedom of the statistic, e.g. 481.0 for a t map over 486 subjects. Needed to convert the map to a p or z image.

subject_species.description: Species of the subjects, e.g. 'homo sapiens'.

surface_left_file.description: URL of the left-hemisphere surface (GIFTI .func.gii) projection of this map, when one exists.

surface_right_file.description: URL of the right-hemisphere surface (GIFTI .func.gii) projection of this map, when one exists.

target_template_image.description: Template the map is registered to, e.g. 'GenericMNI'.

thumbnail.description: URL of the glass-brain preview image, e.g. 'http://neurovault.org/media/images/457/glass_brain_3128.jpg'.

name: NeuroVault_list_atlases
description: List labeled anatomical brain atlas maps (parcellation/label images) hosted on NeuroVault. Each atlas is a label image (NIfTI) paired with a label-description file (XML/text) that names each parcel/region. Returns metadata including name, the .nii.gz file URL, the label_description_file URL, and the parent collection. Use limit and offset for pagination. NeuroVault hosts 18 atlases. Example: returns atlases like 'Thalamus maxprob thr25 2mm'.

limit.description: Maximum number of atlases to return per page (default 10, validated max 1000). Example: 10

offset.description: Number of atlases to skip for pagination (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_offset.

oneOf.description: Paginated list of NeuroVault atlas maps

file.description: URL to the label image NIfTI file (.nii.gz)

label_description_file.description: URL to the label-description file (XML/text) naming each parcel

url.description: URL to view collection on NeuroVault

data_origin.description: Whether the map came from the 'volume' or from a surface, e.g. 'volume'.

file_size.description: Size of the stored map in bytes, e.g. 1180649.

is_valid.description: Whether NeuroVault's own validation of the file passed, e.g. true.

modify_date.description: When the image record was last changed, e.g. '2018-06-30T07:03:20.571134+02:00'.

subject_species.description: Species of the subjects, e.g. 'homo sapiens'.

surface_right_file.description: URL of the right-hemisphere surface (GIFTI .func.gii) projection of this map, when one exists.

target_template_image.description: Template the map is registered to, e.g. 'GenericMNI'.

thumbnail.description: URL of the glass-brain preview image, e.g. 'http://neurovault.org/media/images/457/glass_brain_3128.jpg'.

name: NeuroVault_get_atlas
description: Get detailed metadata for a single labeled anatomical brain atlas map in NeuroVault by its atlas ID. Returns the atlas name, the label image NIfTI file URL (.nii.gz), the label_description_file URL (XML/text naming each parcel/region), the parent collection, and acquisition metadata. Get an atlas ID from NeuroVault_list_atlases. Example: id=14228 returns 'Thalamus maxprob thr25 2mm', file Thalamus-maxprob-thr25-2mm.nii.gz, label_description_file Thalamus-maxprob-thr25-2mm.xml, collection 1056.

atlas_id.description: NeuroVault atlas image ID. Get one from NeuroVault_list_atlases. Example: 14228 (Thalamus maxprob thr25 2mm).

file.description: URL to the label image NIfTI file (.nii.gz)

label_description_file.description: URL to the label-description file (XML/text) naming each parcel/region

url.description: URL to view collection on NeuroVault

data_origin.description: Whether the map came from the 'volume' or from a surface, e.g. 'volume'.

file_size.description: Size of the stored map in bytes, e.g. 1180649.

is_valid.description: Whether NeuroVault's own validation of the file passed, e.g. true.

modify_date.description: When the image record was last changed, e.g. '2018-06-30T07:03:20.571134+02:00'.

subject_species.description: Species of the subjects, e.g. 'homo sapiens'.

surface_left_file.description: URL of the left-hemisphere surface (GIFTI .func.gii) projection of this map, when one exists.

surface_right_file.description: URL of the right-hemisphere surface (GIFTI .func.gii) projection of this map, when one exists.

thumbnail.description: URL of the glass-brain preview image, e.g. 'http://neurovault.org/media/images/457/glass_brain_3128.jpg'.
